milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate/observe task. The player must navigate near the heavy weighted pressure plate at spawn-relative (-3, 0, -3) in the NW corner and face toward it, confirming they have visually located it. This is preferred over position_inside_box for find tasks as it models 'player can see the target'.

Uses inventory_has because mining the crafting table causes it to drop as an item which the player picks up into their inventory. The player starts with an empty inventory so this cannot be a false positive at initialization.

Uses inventory_has because crafting iron boots (4 iron ingots in the boot pattern on a 3x3 crafting grid) results in iron_boots appearing in the player's inventory. The player starts with no iron boots so this cannot be a false positive at initialization.
